**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Meetings
- **The other side is recorded automatically.** The "Online meeting / In person" switch is gone. WhisperShortcut now picks from your output device: with headphones it records your Mac's sound (Teams, Zoom, Meet) along with the microphone; on speakers it records the microphone only, so nothing echoes twice. It follows the switch if you plug headphones in or out during a meeting.
- The meeting bar shows what is being recorded ("Headphones · others via Mac sound" / "Speakers · microphone only"). Its menu lets you override the choice: Automatic (by output device), Always mix in Mac sound, or Microphone only.
- The first meeting with headphones asks once for macOS "Screen & System Audio Recording" permission.

## German
- **Settings and error messages are now fully in German.** On a Mac set to German, the remaining English texts in Settings are translated (popup position, "not set up" hints, Glossary and system prompt hints, the new Own server options), and so are about 130 error messages: providers, ChatGPT sign-in, mail, disk space, local model timeouts and the AI app approval window.

## Settings
- **"Advanced" opens again with one click.** In Meetings and About, clicking anywhere on the "Advanced" row expands it, not just the small arrow.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.66...v8.67
